messages:
Anya: FYI brought kumori-v2 int8 into staging, seeing a locale-specific regression for mixed KO+ZH. BLEU ~-6 on ko_zh_dev, some integration tests failing. Reproducer attached.

eval-bot: REGRESSION_SUMMARY: model=kumori-v2-int8 metric=BLEU delta=-6.2 dataset=ko_zh_mixed_dev id=RG-2026-311

Sasha: Paste a couple concrete examples and token id diffs please.

Anya: Example (input -> baseline -> int8):
input: "서울역에서 北京行 버스가 멈췄다"
baseline: "버스가 서울역에서 北京(북경)으로 출발했다."
int8_out: "버스가 서울역에서 京으로 출발했다." -- lost han grouping.
Token ids baseline vs int8: [1342,9001,2345,7810] -> [1342,9001,2350,7810] (2345 remapped to 2350).

Kevin: That suggests a vocab remap in the quant serializer. Any converter logs?

Anya: Logs: [2026-02-11 08:12:03] serialize_vocab remap_table_entries=3; [2026-02-11 08:12:03] applied_remap {old:2345,new:2350}. We didn't expect remap_entries>0.

Lia: Hypotheses: (1) converter emitted a reordered token-table, (2) runtime int8 preprocessing normalizes ZWJ/ZWSP differently.

Sasha: @Kevin can you bisect converter commits 2026-02-01..2026-02-12 with the ko_zh fixture?

Kevin: Running ./tools/quant_bisect --model kumori-v2 --from 2026-02-01 --to 2026-02-12 --repro tests/fixtures/ko_zh_mixed.txt. Early result: commit 2026-02-09 reproduces remap.

Tori: Add token-id-stability smoke to staging gating for mixed-script inputs.

Anya: Pinned staging to kumori-v2-fp16 (int8 rollout blocked). I opened ENG-ML-1284 to track cross-locale runs (zh-jp, ja-kr).

Kevin: Found offending commit sha d9f7e8 on 2026-02-09  serializer remap naive collision solver. Opening PR to revert and add deterministic tests.

Tori: After revert, schedule full smoke fleet (quant vs fp16) for top locales and add quant CI regression guard.

Anya: Assigning follow-ups: Kevin=revert PR & bisect summary; Anya=token-stability tests + smoke fleet run; Tori=quant CI alert & gating rule; Lia=serializer heuristic review and deterministic proposal.

eval-bot: RG-2026-311 status=triaged owner=Kevin PR=PR-5387
